mei: Heads-up: int8 bringup for orion-v3-nightly showing weird token merging around fullwidth numbers + ZWJ in vertical/ja/zh samples. Repro on our smoke set :eyes:
mei: Example from failing sample: 日本 -> (actually shows as) 「年1\u200d」 turning into "1年" without the expected narrow no-break space/ZWJ preserved.
mei: Minimal repro snippet pasted below:
```bash
# run small smoke eval
./eval_local.sh --model orion-v3-int8 --locale ja --samples tests/vertical_furigana/003.json --mode detok_compare
```
mei: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/evals/73621 (shows bleu/wer jumps on int8)
tian: can you paste the raw input and two detoks (fp16 vs int8)?
mei: raw input line: "明年1\u200d, ３, ４"
mei: fp16 detok: "明 年 1, ３, ４"
mei: int8 detok: "1年 ３ ４"  <-- note the numeric 1 moved before the ideograph and the ZWJ/narrowspace removed
alex: interesting, sounds like a tokenizer subtoken merge + detok ordering bug introduced by qkv kernel rounding? :thinking_face:
alex: did we change byte-level normalization in quant pipeline last week? commit 9a7b3e3 changed the pretokenize step on export.
sophia: pinging @triage-bot for bisect begun: triage-bot, kick off bisect between 9a7b3e3..HEAD on orion-v3 export flow?
triage-bot: bisect started: testing 14 commits, will report suspected commit id to thread when first fail is reproduced.
tian: re-run quick sanity with tokenizer-only (no model) to isolate:
```py
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.load('orion-v3-vocab.json')
for s in ['明\u200d年1', '明\u200d年\uff11']:
    print(s, '->', t.tokenize(s), '->', t.detokenize(t.tokenize(s)))
```
tian: if tokenizer detok already wrong then model quantization not culprit.
mei: ran tokenizer-only, detok was OK on my machine (fp env). So likely interplay with kv cache / generation ordering when quantized.
alex: can you capture a short generation trace with kv indices and tokens for both fp16 and int8? that should show where reordering happens.
mei: capturing now, will attach logs. small excerpt:
```
FP16: token seq [<BOS>, 明, \u200d, 年, 1, <EOS>] -> detok '明\u200d年1'
INT8: token seq [<BOS>, 1, 明, \u200d, 年, <EOS>] -> detok '1明\u200d年'
```
mei: so token emission order differs. suspect kernel that handles prefix KV write is non-deterministic under fused int8 attention when sequence contains ZWJ or CJK digits (unicode categories).
tian: that matches a recent flaky attention write we saw on GPU driver 525. triage-bot, please note GPU driver kernel variant too.
triage-bot: bisect update: first failing commit located at 9a7b3e3 (export change) + repro only when using int8 export path + driver 525.* on p4d nodes.
sophia: immediate mitigation: add a small post-detok pass to preserve ZWJ placement for CJK+digits locales until we fix kernel. can we ship a temporary fudge in runtime?
alex: yeah, add locale-aware postprocess in detok pipeline: reinsert ZWJ/narrowspace between ideograph and following ascii digit if original had it. Low risk.
mei: create PR with tests against failing samples and smoke dashboard. tagging eng-runtime for review.
tian: follow-up: need regression tests on CI that run detok parity for a handful of vertical/furigana/ZWJ samples on int8. add to nightly.
mei: thanks everyone. I attached small triage notes and logs to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-1289 :thumbsup:
sophia: filed runtime PR DRAFT #4321, added unit tests and a flag to enable temporary fix per-deployment.
triage-bot: bisect completed, root cause metadata attached to ticket INF-1289.
mei: leaving this thread open until eng-runtime approves patch and CI green. :eyes:
